title: Tania Rascia: career as a short prose timeline (chef → engineer)
note: 'A brief timeline' on the homepage: four rows with a mono date range on the left (1998–2006, 2007–2014, 2014–2020, 2021–now) and one sentence each, with the key phrase linked in magenta ('Professional chef', 'Career change', 'Principal software engineer'), ending on real numbers (177 posts, 20,000+ stars).
